From: Tom Carter <tom.carter@healthprime.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthprime.com
Date: Wed, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Residency confirmation & SIG index for Private Deploy

Hi Vivek / Connor,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. HealthPrime is proceeding with an internal risk review for the pilot and the reviewers have asked for a compact evidence package focused on region residency and operator controls for Redwood Private deployment. Specifically they asked for: 

- A filled CAIQ index (or mapping) for our Private deployment profile (preferably the latest XLSX).
- The SIG addendum or mapping that specifically calls out private/VPC deployment differences from your hosted offering.
- An ops diagram showing VPC peering, egress paths, and where KMS/HSM keys are provisioned (we need to see physical region boundaries).
- Operator manifest or roster (roles that can access keys/hosts) and a short note on operator vetting (background checks/contractors).
- Any SOC2 exhibits that reference region/data locality or the SOC2 control IDs that map to residency.

If possible, can you also confirm whether Redwood will sign a short one-page region-commitment letter (non-binding operational commitment) for the EU-only pilot? Our legal team has asked for that as an aide to procurement.

Can you provide the evidence package as a secure bundle (we prefer a presigned URL or DocuSign package) by end-of-day Friday (two business days)?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Tom
Tom Carter
Head of Security Programs
HealthPrime
[phone redacted]

- Region-commitment letter: attached as sig-addendum cover page (operational one-pager). If you want an executed letter, we can issue a signed PDF via DocuSign.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you want the full SOC2 report or DocuSign-executed commitment. Happy to jump on a short call tomorrow to run through any control mappings.
